Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly identify the specific OpenCV version that added Mask-RCNN support (which was version 3.3.0, released in 2018) and the associated contributors. Instead, it hallucinated a specific contributor named "Wen Jia Bao" (likely confusing the name with former Chinese Premier Wen Jiabao) as the answer to the search query. The search results provided in the conversation show a GitHub issue (#11412) mentioning a contributor named "@baranorbart" who merged the PR, but the WebSurfer ignored this and generated a completely incorrect name that coincidentally matched a Chinese political figure, failing the core logic of the problem which requires finding a contributor whose name *matches* a former head of government, not inventing one. The Orchestrator then incorrectly accepted this hallucination as the "Final Answer".
